description: Ingest events from a PostHog project via the /events REST API. Cursor-paginated. Returns a DataFrame with flattened event fields.

outputs.description: pandas DataFrame with one row per vendor record. Chain a downstream sink component (dataframe_to_snowflake / _to_bigquery / _to_duckdb / ...) to persist.

api_host.description: PostHog API host. Use 'https://us.i.posthog.com' (default) for US Cloud, 'https://eu.i.posthog.com' for EU Cloud, or your self-hosted URL.
api_host.label: API Host

api_key_env_var.description: Env var holding a PostHog personal API key with `query:read` scope.
api_key_env_var.label: API Key Env Var

since_days.description: Fetch events from the last N days (max 90).
since_days.label: Since Days

limit.description: Total row cap. Paginates until this limit or all events fetched.
limit.label: Limit

include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview Metadata
include_preview_metadata.description: Include sample data preview in metadata

preview_rows.label: Preview Rows
preview_rows.description: How many rows to include in the preview. Large tables (>10× this number) are sampled randomly.
